No TwinCAT project Volt measured holds such a box, so writing one is unmeasured here. Refusing to write this network; a network whose text is unchanged is kept as the IDE holds it. The IDE can edit this network.

Volt rebuilds a changed network through TwinCAT's PLCopen import, which is not measured for that shape, so the push is refused before the import rather than risk a network that comes back different.
